description: This file defines the WithTokenParser class within the Twig templating engine, responsible for parsing the 'with' tag to create nested scopes in templates.

classes.name: Twig	okenParser\WithTokenParser
classes.description: Final class that extends AbstractTokenParser to handle parsing of the 'with' tag in Twig templates.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses the 'with' tag and its contents, creating a WithNode representing a nested scope.

methods.name: decideWithEnd
methods.description: Determines if the current token marks the end of the 'with' block.

methods.name: getTag
methods.description: Returns the tag name associated with this parser, which is 'with'.
